parsed.summary: The PR introduces a check to make RenameModel a no-op if the db_table is the same, which is a reasonable addition. However, it lacks tests to ensure the change behaves as expected in all scenarios.

issues.description: The PR does not include any tests to verify that the new check correctly identifies when a RenameModel operation should be a no-op. This is crucial to ensure the change does not introduce unexpected behavior.
